en: Black-and-white view over a dense historic town with steep, tiled roofs climbing up a hillside toward a large Gothic cathedral with two ornate western towers and a tall, slender spire behind it. To the right stands a bulky complex with a tower topped by an onion-shaped dome. Narrow streets and trees weave between the tightly packed houses. The overall look is of a Central European medieval cityscape photographed from an elevated vantage point.
